items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Howard's a good trumpet player, and so we hired him

ctx.x: Okay, we got that one straightened out. How about Howard McGee, how did he happen to get in your band?
Well, we needed a trumpet player and Howard's a good trumpet player, and so we hired him.

items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And I was working with Charlie Barnet at the time.

ctx.x: Taking everybody. They was tough. But I told them, I said, "Shit, I don't know. I'll shoot any son of a bitch that's White that comes up in front of me." And they said, "No, we can't use you." And I was working with Charlie Barnet at the time.
